text:
marta: Heads-up — we got a partner ask from Flowforge + LangChain to do a 'gateway -> orchestrator' joint demo next Wed. Need alignment on assets, demo flow, and talking points. cc @alex @devon
alex: Quick q — are they expecting full token passthrough or an adapter-level demo (simpler)?
devon: They want adapter + sample repo that shows branching orchestration and a stateful tool call. Think step functions style.
ryan: We should surface Redwood routing-by-policy and the fallback behavior; also a simple perf stat (p95 tokens) for the demo story.
marta: Agreed. Marketing asked for a joint blog + partner quote. Do we need legal/PR signoff or a quick NDA?
integrations-bot: New partner request created: PRJ-4821 — https://redwood.internal/partners/PRJ-4821
alex: I'll own the technical checklist (adapter tests, README, example workflow). Who can own runbook + infra sandbox?
devon: I can spin up a dedicated sandbox for the demo. Need partner SSH keys, allowed egress list, and model variant preference (we should confirm quantized variant okay).
marta: @devon please add a short env list + sample workload items to PRJ-4821. @samira do we have logo + co-marketing approval window?
samira: Marketing: we need ~2 weeks for blog review but can do a co-author skeleton by Monday. Also ask partners for a 2-3 sentence partner quote early.
ryan: I'll ping Legal for the quote/PR checklist and request credits for a dedicated demo slot. ETA EOD Friday.
alex: Tech checklist draft: adapter repo, orchestrator workflow.yaml, small preloaded dataset, README + runbook. I'll open a skeleton PR and tag reviewers.
devon: Smoke test plan I'll run in the sandbox: 1) auth flow 2) model failover to compatible variant 3) KV cache warmup 4) latency under load (50 concurrent). Will post results in PRJ-4821.
marta: Can we schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 9am PT to agree owners and demo narrative? Reply with :thumbsup: if you can make it.
samira: :thumbsup:
ryan: :thumbsup:
alex: :thumbsup:
devon: :thumbsup:
marta: Awesome — calendar invite sent. Agenda: runbook owner, demo narrative, assets + legal next steps. Thanks everyone.
